available_tools.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details.
available_tools.name: send_email

available_tools.description: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.
available_tools.name: delete_email

available_tools.description:
Returns all the unread emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
The emails are marked as read after this function is called.
available_tools.name: get_unread_emails

available_tools.description: Returns all the sent emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.
available_tools.name: get_sent_emails

available_tools.description: Returns all the received emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.
available_tools.name: get_received_emails

available_tools.description: Returns all the draft emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.
available_tools.name: get_draft_emails

available_tools.description:
Searches for emails in the inbox that contain the given query in the subject or body. If `address` is provided,
only emails from that address are searched.
available_tools.name: search_emails

available_tools.description:
Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by name.
It returns a list of contacts that match the given name.
available_tools.name: search_contacts_by_name

available_tools.description:
Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by email.
It returns a list of contacts that match the given email.
available_tools.name: search_contacts_by_email

available_tools.description:
Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'.
It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant
should not assume what the current date is.
available_tools.name: get_current_day

available_tools.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.
available_tools.name: search_calendar_events

available_tools.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.
available_tools.name: get_day_calendar_events

available_tools.description:
Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar.
It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.
available_tools.name: create_calendar_event

available_tools.description:
Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar.
It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation.
available_tools.name: cancel_calendar_event

available_tools.description:
Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times.
It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling.
available_tools.name: reschedule_calendar_event

available_tools.description:
Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`.
It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event.
available_tools.name: add_calendar_event_participants

available_tools.description: Append content to a file in the cloud drive.
available_tools.name: append_to_file

available_tools.description:
Get a file from a cloud drive by its filename. It returns a list of files.
Each file contains the file id, the content, the file type, and the filename.
available_tools.name: search_files_by_filename

available_tools.description: Create a new file in the cloud drive.
available_tools.name: create_file

available_tools.description:
Delete a file from the cloud drive by its filename.
It returns the file that was deleted.
available_tools.name: delete_file

available_tools.description: Get a file from a cloud drive by its ID.
available_tools.name: get_file_by_id

available_tools.description: Retrieve all files in the cloud drive.
available_tools.name: list_files

available_tools.description: Share a file with a user.
available_tools.name: share_file

available_tools.description: Search for files in the cloud drive by content.
available_tools.name: search_files
